spans.s:
गोपः (पी f.) [गुप्-अच्]
1 One
who guards or protects; शालिगोप्यो
जगुर्यशः

.
--2 Hiding,
concealment.
--3 Reviling, abuse.
--4
Flurry, agitation.
--5 Light, lustre,
splendour.

गोपनं [गुप् भावे ल्युट्]
1 Guarding,
protecting.
--2 Hiding, concealing.
--3 Reviling, abuse.
--4 Flurry, hurry,
alarm.
--5 Light, lustre.
--6 Envy,
[]
jealousy.
--7 Perplexity, confusion.
--ना
1 Protection.
--2 Light, lustre.

गोपनीय a.
1 To be preserved or
protected.
--2 To be prevented.
--3
To be concealed or hidden.
--4 Secret,
mysterious.

गोपायक a. A preserver, defender,
one who guards.

गोप्तृ a. (प्त्री f.) [गुप्-तृच्]
1 A
protector, preserver, guardian; तस्मिन्वनं
गोप्तरि गाहमाने

.
--2 One who hides
or conceals. --m. An epithet of
Viṣṇu.

गोप्य a. [गुप् कर्मणि यत्]
1 To be
protected.
--2 To be kept secret or
hidden;

.
--3 To be kept, to
be taken care of.
--4 To be cherished
--प्यः
1 A servant, slave.
--2 A son
of a female slave.
--Comp.
--आधिः
a pledge to be carefully preserved.
